The season started on 21 August 2014. [[Al-Duhail SC|Lekhwiya]], the defending champions, won their fourth league title with one matchday remaining by winning against [[Al Ahli SC (Doha)|Al Ahli]] on 12 April 2015. ==Teams== [[Al-Shamal SC|Al-Shamal]] were promoted as champions from the 2nd Division. They last played in the top flight in [[2009–10 Qatar Stars League|2009–10]]. They were joined by 2nd Division runners up [[Al Shahaniya SC|Al Shahaniya]] who entered the top flight for the first time in their history. Relegated teams were [[Muaither SC|Muaither]] who lasted one season in the top flight and former power-house outfit [[Al-Rayyan SC|Al-Rayyan]]. ===Stadia and locations=== {{Location map+ |Qatar |width=300 |float=right |caption=Locations of teams in the 2014–15 Qatari League |places= {{Location map~ |Qatar |lat=25.286667 |long=51.533333 |label=Doha }} {{Location map~ |Qatar |lat=25.7 |long=51.666667 |label=Umm Salal |position=right}} {{Location map~ |Qatar |lat=25.69|long=51.51 |label=Al Khor |position=left}} }} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="text-align: center;" !
